Title: AI Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist- AI




Barcelona, Spain

Hybrid- 2 days a week




We’re looking for a Data Scientist to help build and improve AI‑powered document processing solutions used across a large, complex organisation. You’ll work across LLMs, multimodal models, OCR, NLP and classical ML to turn messy, unstructured business documents into reliable structured data that drives real value.

In this role, you’ll design and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification and validation — “Design, prototype and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification, validation and transformation.” You’ll also work with highly variable formats — “Work with complex and variable formats, including multi‑page documents, tables, line items and inconsistent layouts.”




What you’ll do

Develop and optimise prompts, structured outputs, validation logic and post‑processing components.
Compare LLMs, multimodal models, OCR and deterministic approaches to select the right solution for each use case.
Build representative datasets, define ground truth and establish robust evaluation metrics.
Run experiments, analyse failure patterns and iterate to improve accuracy and reliability.
Create reproducible Python workflows and contribute reusable components for extraction, validation and data prep.
Collaborate with Product, AI Engineering and business teams to translate requirements into measurable data science problems.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.




What you’ll bring

3+ years in data science, machine learning or applied AI.
Hands‑on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering and experimentation.
Strong NLP/ML fundamentals and the judgement to know when classical methods outperform LLMs.
Solid statistics — enough to judge whether a performance change is real.
Experience with unstructured or semi‑structured documents.
Python skills that make your work reproducible and easy for engineers to productionise.
Good coding practices: testing, version control, code review, reproducible experiments.
Ability to explain technical trade‑offs clearly.
Comfortable diving into business domains to understand what “correct extraction” actually means.




Nice to have

Document intelligence / OCR (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence).
Experience with managed AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock).

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: VIE Barcelone (12 mois) - Data Scientist H/F
Description:
Intégré à l’équipe du Data & IA Hub, vous rejoindrez une jeune équipe composée de Data Scientists, Data Engineers et ML Engineers.




Vous travaillerez sur deux missions principales :




En mode projet, vous participerez au pilotage de A à Z de projets finaux : collecte des données, pipeline de prétraitement, modélisation et déploiement. Vous contribuerez au développement des 4 axes principaux du groupe :
Inspection 4.0 : développements d’algorithmes de computer vision et NLP en soutien aux experts métiers sur le terrain
Assistants SOCOTEC : développement d’agents personnalisés pour les services du groupe (RAG, text-to-SQL, …)
IA+X pour des nouveaux services : développement de technique d’hybridation entre physique et IA (jumeau numérique, PINN)
Extraction d’information à partir de documents et de plans
Vous choisirez un sujet de R&D pour vous confronter à l’état de l’art du domaine avec des possibilités de publication scientifique. Les sujets sont présentés et détaillés ci-après:
Inspection 4.0 : Machine learning appliqué à l’inspection des ouvrages d’art
Détection de presque accident sur chantier assitée par IA : EPILOG
Auto-completion de contenu technique pour assister à la rédaction des rapports
Agent de génération de rapport avec canevas intégré dans une plateforme LLM
Agent de Knowledge Management (AXONE IA, RESOTECH IA) employés des techniques de RAG avancés
Smart speech-to-text : transcription et extraction intelligente d'informations avec des LLMs




Le travail sera fait en collaboration avec une équipe de développeurs pour développer les modèles et héberger les livrables sur une plateforme web AWS.




Un niveau courant en Espagnol et en Anglais sont nécessaires à l'accomplissement des missions.

Vous ferez preuve d’autonomie, de sagacité et de qualités certaines dans la rédaction et la communication de son code.

Title: Data Science / Machine Learning graduate
Description:
Symrise is a global leader in creating inspiring fragrance, flavor, nutrition, and health solutions. Within Group IT, we are expanding our established Global Data & AI Hub in Barcelona (Poblenou), which has successfully launched and continues to grow as a key pillar of our digital transformation strategy.

The Global Data & AI Graduate Career Program is now entering its next intake, building on the success of previous cohorts. It offers early-career talent the opportunity to join a proven and evolving program that combines structured learning, hands-on experience, and exposure to real-world global business challenges.

As part of the 2026 intake, we offer a range of specialized graduate tracks including AI Enablement & Community, Application / Full-Stack Development, Data Engineering, Data Science / Machine Learning, DevOps, Integration / API Engineering, and UX/UI Design. Each role contributes to building innovative, data-driven, and scalable digital solutions within a truly global and agile environment.



About the Program



The 12-month global program is designed for recent graduates who want to launch their careers with Symrise through a structured and immersive learning journey.

You will benefit from:
- Formal technical and professional training
- Hands-on work in real global projects
- Continuous tutoring and personal mentoring
- Exposure to senior leadership
- A highly collaborative, agile, and international environment

This program is built to accelerate your growth, strengthen your technical expertise, and help you develop into a future expert in your field.

Your role

As a Data Science / Machine Learning Trainee, you will gain hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a global enterprise environment. You will work with diverse datasets-including structured, unstructured, text, image, and time-series data-contributing to AI-driven applications and data products that support key business functions.

In this role, you will support the full machine learning lifecycle, from data exploration and feature engineering to model development, experimentation, and performance evaluation. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, MLOps, and solution teams to help operationalize models, integrating them into scalable, production-ready systems. You will also explore modern AI approaches, including generative AI and language models, contributing to innovative use cases such as copilots, recommendation systems, and advanced analytics.

Working alongside both technical teams and business stakeholders, you will help translate analytical insights into real-world impact. You will contribute to responsible AI practices, ensuring models are reliable, ethical, and aligned with governance standards. This role offers a strong learning opportunity to build practical skills in machine learning, AI engineering, and applied data science within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

You should have:

A Master's degree in a relevant field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Cybersecurity, UX/UI Design, or similar)
Graduation no later than 31 July 2026
Maximum 2 years of prior professional experience in a similar role
Availability to start full-time in September 2026

Eligibility requirements:

EU citizenship is required (we do not offer visa sponsorship)
For candidates based in Spain, employment will be under a local Spanish contract
For eligible candidates outside of Spain, employment may be arranged via the VIE program (subject to Business France eligibility rules)
Candidates must not have previously completed a VIE assignment
Age must be under 29 at the time of hiring
Willingness to relocate to Barcelona (Poblenou)

You ideally bring:

Strong analytical and/or technical skills depending on the role
Interest in data, AI, software development, or digital innovation
Strong communication and collaboration skills
A proactive, curious, and learning-oriented mindset
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment
Advanced English (C1 / TOEFL 95+)

A unique opportunity to start your career in our established and expanding Global Data & AI Hub in Barcelona (Poblenou).

You can expect:
- 12-month paid graduate program €32,000
- Private health and life insurance
- Flexible working arrangements
- Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
- International exposure and cross-functional collaboration
- Learning, development, and certification opportunities
- Modern, collaborative workplace

At the end of the program, there is a possibility of a permanent role within Symrise, depending on performance and business needs.

Title: Principal Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Our Business

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; with a team of more than 3000+ experts serving its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team. In this role you will lead a team of two data scientists while staying hands-on in delivery yourself. You will bring not only technical expertise but also a deep understanding of business operations and strategy. The work you and your team produce will directly influence decision-making and help shape the future of our organization through actionable insights drawn from complex datasets.

As a Data Science Lead, you will set the direction and priorities for the team, coach your data scientists in their technical and professional growth, and personally own the most complex projects end to end. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, product managers, and engineers, to design and implement data-driven solutions that align with the company’s goals, translating complex data into business value through machine learning, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

This is deliberately a hybrid role. We are not looking for someone who only directs work: you will spend a meaningful share of your time building models, writing code and reviewing your team’s output, and you should want to keep it that way.

Key Responsibilities:


Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach and grow a team of two data scientists — setting objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, giving feedback, and actively supporting their technical and career development.
Hands-on Delivery: Stay personally involved in delivery, owning the most complex or business-critical projects end to end and setting the technical standard for the team through code reviews and pairing.
Planning & Prioritisation: Manage the team’s backlog and capacity, balance competing stakeholder requests, and make sure work is delivered at a predictable pace and quality.
Business Insight Development: Understand the key business challenges and opportunities, and use data to develop solutions that align with strategic objectives.
Data Strategy: Own the data science roadmap together with leadership, defining priorities based on business needs and opportunities, and translating them into a concrete plan for your team.
Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning: Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to forecast trends, optimize processes, and drive business outcomes.
Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data science pipeline: Advise, build and continuously improve the data science pipeline which best responds to team.blue analytics needs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business leaders, product teams, and engineers to ensure that data solutions meet business requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest trends in data science, AI, and machine learning to continuously improve the team’s capabilities.



Requirements:


Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data science, including at least 3 years in a data science lead, team lead or equivalent leadership position, with a proven track record of solving complex business problems using data.
Proven Leadership Experience: Demonstrable experience line-managing and developing data scientists. You can point to concrete examples of people you have hired, coached or grown, and of teams you have led through delivery.
Hands-on Credibility: You are still actively building — comfortable writing production-quality code, reviewing your team’s work, and being the person others come to when a problem is genuinely hard.
Stakeholder Management: Experience representing a data science team to senior stakeholders: setting expectations, saying no when needed, and defending the team’s priorities.
Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to align data science projects with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical insights into business recommendations and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to handle complex and unstructured data.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Experience with SQL and working with large data sets.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).).



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Make is the platform to manage all your automations and AI agents in one visual landscape – for teams driving business impact without relying on developers. Part of Celonis, a global leader in process intelligence recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 for seven consecutive years, we're headquartered in Prague, Czechia, with hubs in Madrid, Munich, Raleigh, and Pristina, and teams across the UK, France, India, and the Netherlands, among other locations.




About The Role

We are seeking a pragmatic, proactive Senior Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, technical mastery is only half the equation - the real priority is translating data science into measurable business value. You will partner closely with business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities, select the right tool for the job (whether a simple logic rule or a complex machine learning model), and independently drive solutions from concept to production.

If you are a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, prioritizes tangible business outcomes over technical complexity for its own sake, and enjoys shaping the data science discipline, we want to hear from you.




Key Responsibilities

Drive Business Value: Partner directly with business stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to identify opportunities and deliver measurable ROI through data science.
Pragmatic Problem Solving: Select and apply the right solution for the problem- prioritizing speed, simplicity, and practical business impact whether the optimal approach is simple heuristics or advanced machine learning.
End-to-End Ownership: Independently lead data science projects from initial scoping and data exploration through to deployment, monitoring, and value realization.
Model Development & Deployment: Build, validate, and maintain scalable analytics and machine learning solutions designed for real-world impact.
Shape the Discipline: Define best practices, methodologies, and tool selection strategy to build a mature, practical data science function at Make.
Cross-Functional Communication: Bridge the gap between technical rigor and business execution, translating complex models into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.




What You'll Bring

Business-First Mindset: 6+ years of experience in data science or analytics, with a proven track record of driving direct business outcomes.
Pragmatic Approach: Strong technical foundations paired with the judgment to choose simple, practical tools over complex frameworks when appropriate.
High Autonomy: Ability to operate independently, proactively identify business gaps, and drive projects through to completion with minimal direction.
Technical Proficiency: Expertise in Python, SQL, and core ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), with practical experience putting models into production.
Stakeholder Partnership: Ability to collaborate effectively with business units, build strong working relationships, and advocate for value-driven data solutions.
Nice-to-Haves: Experience in SaaS environments or building and deploying LLMs and generative AI workflows.




What we offer

📝 RSUs grant in a rapidly growing company raising its value every day
💸 Annual bonus
🌎 Multinational team with 42 nationalities creating the future of automation
🎓 Learning & Development plan (online language, professional courses, conference tickets and other trainings) & 2 Company Learning Days per year
🌳 1 Company Impact Day per year
🍎 Notebook/Macbook
🏝 25 days of vacation
🫶 10 care days to care for your loved ones
👨 👩 👧 👦 Extra parental vacation (3-6 months)
👶 RSUs grant for a newborn child
☂️ Life insurance
🏋️ Gympass
💳 Meal and transportation tickets, medical insurance
🥳 Team buildings, parties, and company events multiple times a year
🏡 Flexible working hours + home office

En Seresco, empresa líder del sector TIC en Asturias, queremos acoger al mejor talento. 🚀Estamos presentes e involucrados en multitud de proyectos a nivel nacional e internacional, utilizando los medios y tecnologías más punteras del mercado.

Puesto estable para proyecto de larga duración
Integración en un equipo multidisciplinar
Desarrollo de carrera profesional, en función de la valía aportada
Modalidad híbrida de teletrabajo
Jornada completa
Centro de trabajo en Oviedo o Vigo
Contrato indefinido

Una política de RRHH que permitirá la integración perfecta de tu vida personal. Política de teletrabajo muy extendida en la Compañía, tendrás una modalidad de trabajo híbrido.

Organización donde todas las puertas están abiertas de verdad.

Titulación en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Informática, Física o disciplinas afines.
Experiencia en análisis estadístico y modelización de datos.
Dominio de Python para análisis de datos y desarrollo de modelos (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL, bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL, especializadas en series temporales de datos, documentales, grafos...
Experiencia con Spark, Databricks o entornos Big Data.
Experiencia en creación y uso de Datalakes y Datalakehouse con herramientas y frameworks opensource (Apache Iceberg, Project Nessie, Trino, Apache Polaris, …).
Experiencia en implementación de arquitectura Medallón.
Conocimientos de ingeniería de datos y procesos ETL.
Experiencia en preparación, limpieza y transformación de datos.
Experiencia en análisis y procesamiento de información geospacial en diferentes formatos.
Capacidad para visualizar datos y comunicar resultados mediante herramientas como Power BI, Tableau o similares.
Experiencia en técnicas de Machine Learning supervisado y no supervisado.
Conocimiento de metodologías de validación y evaluación de modelos.
Manejo de Git y buenas prácticas de desarrollo colaborativo.


Se valorará:


Experiencia con Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Conocimientos de IA Generativa y modelos de lenguaje (LLMs).
Experiencia con herramientas de MLOps y despliegue de modelos.
Conocimientos de arquitecturas cloud (Azure, AWS o Google Cloud).
Certificaciones en Data Science, IA o plataformas cloud.


En Seresco estamos comprometidos con el fomento de la Diversidad, la Inclusión, la Responsabilidad Social, la Igualdad entre hombres y mujeres y la Sostenibilidad en nuestro ambiente de trabajo. Title: Senior Data Scientist (IA & Machine Learning) – Bilbao / Modelo híbrido
Description:
Senior Data Scientist (IA & Machine Learning) – Bilbao (modelo híbrido)




Trabajo con una empresa que se dedica solo a proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning. Nada de proyectos genéricos: foco 100% en datos, modelos y soluciones de IA en producción para sectores como industria, fitness, agro, energía, turismo, etc. Lo mejor: los proyectos se diseñan para acabar en producción, no para quedarse en un PPT.




Ejemplos de proyectos reales:

Predicción del par de apriete de las ruedas para la principal fábrica de furgonetas de España.
Predicción de probabilidad de vuelta al gimnasio de personas de baja para una de las mayores cadenas de gimnasios de España.
Sistema RAG para consulta de información turística en un gran ayuntamiento de la Costa Dorada.
Gemelo digital del proceso productivo para optimizar la fabricación de tubos de acero sin soldar en una empresa cotizada.




¿Cuál es el Rol?

Buscan un/a Senior Data Scientist (5+ años) para liderar soluciones analíticas end-to-end y convertir desafíos de negocio en modelos de alto impacto, con foco en ver los modelos funcionando en producción.




¿Qué se ofrece?

Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes.
23 días de vacaciones al año + el día de tu cumpleaños libre, con libertad para organizarte las vacaciones.
Plan de carrera definido con criterios claros y objetivos para evolucionar dentro de la compañía.
Comida gratis los días que vayas a la oficina y el mejor pintxo de tortilla cuando está todo el equipo.
Formación continua: reuniones técnicas semanales para compartir conocimiento de proyectos, formación mensual dentro de la compañía y 3.000€ al año para la formación que más te interese.
Acompañamiento en tu carrera: one-to-one semanal con una persona con más experiencia y reuniones trimestrales de seguimiento con el CEO para evaluar tu evolución profesional.




¿Qué harás en este puesto?

A corto plazo, participarás en un detector de anomalías para un gestor de plantas renovables y en un proyecto para una gran cadena de gimnasios.
Liderarás el planteamiento de modelos de Machine Learning a aplicar y las métricas en los proyectos en los que participes, así como su puesta en producción.
Te encargarás del desarrollo end-to-end: extracción de datos (BigQuery, Redshift), EDA con Plotly, entrenamiento de modelos con pipelines de scikit-learn, creación de APIS con FastAPI y Dash cuando sea necesario y despliegue en la infraestructura del cliente (Docker, Dokploy, Cloud Run, etc.).
Dejarás las soluciones encapsuladas en librerías Python instalables, documentadas y testadas.
Darás soporte a científicos/as de datos con menor experiencia dentro del equipo.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia de al menos 5 años trabajando en proyectos de datos/IA/ML.
Capacidad para desarrollar código limpio, entendible y mantenible en Python, orientado a soluciones robustas, mantenibles y profesionales para el cliente.
Experiencia en planteamiento y desarrollo de modelos de ML para resolver problemas de negocio con IA, ML y Analítica Avanzada (predicción numérica, clasificación, RAGs, optimizadores, etc.).
Experiencia creando pipelines de ML robustos, que faciliten la puesta en producción e incorporen buenas prácticas para anticipar y resolver problemas.
Conocimiento en creación de APIs y frontends: haber creado APIs (idealmente FastAPI u otros frameworks) y algún front sencillo para que el cliente consuma la aplicación (Dash u otros frameworks, o HTML y CSS).
Conocimientos de infra y despliegue: experiencia desplegando en infra de cliente (Google Cloud, Azure, VMs, etc.), trabajando con contenedores y servicios gestionados, sin necesidad de ser perfil DevOps.
Soft skills: capacidad de trabajar en equipo, autonomía en la ejecución de tareas, habilidad para liderar reuniones técnicas con cliente y ganas de seguir aprendiendo y mejorando.




¿Dónde lo harás?

Oficinas en Bilbao.
Preferencia por un modelo de trabajo híbrido, valorando la cultura de equipo en oficina.
Visitas ocasionales a oficinas de clientes en fases estratégicas de los proyectos.




¿Cuál es la forma de trabajar?

Organización mediante metodologías ágiles, fomentando transparencia y comunicación continua.
Reunión de coordinación todos los lunes para planificar la semana y definir las tareas de cada persona.
Uso de Jira y Microsoft Teams para comunicación y gestión de proyectos.
Autonomía para planificar y ejecutar tus tareas, con apoyo de equipos de negocio y técnicos cuando lo necesites.
Cultura basada en confianza, responsabilidad compartida y aportación de cada persona al éxito colectivo.




¿Con quién trabajarás?

Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar de 8 personas, combinando data scientists, traductores de negocio y perfiles de marketing/operaciones.
Reportarás y tendrás seguimiento directo de un CEO y un Lead Data Scientist con más de 10 años de experiencia en IA/ML, docencia en programas de Big Data & Business Intelligence y múltiples proyectos de IA aplicada en empresa.
Trabajarás codo con codo con perfiles de negocio que traducen las necesidades del cliente y ayudan a llevar los modelos a adopción real en operación.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

At Macadam, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over 15 million users worldwide, we help individuals turn their daily steps into positive habits for health, wellbeing, and sustainability.

Our team is growing fast, and our ambitions are global. We operate at the intersection of health, gamification, and technology, and we're building a world-class data team to support this growth.

If you’re passionate about using data and machine learning to build products that improve lives at scale, we’d love to meet you.

Please submit your CV in English.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape Macadam’s product and growth strategy through machine learning, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

You will work on high-impact topics such as personalization, user engagement, retention, monetization, fraud prevention, and reward economy optimization. This is a hands-on senior role with ownership from problem definition through deployment and impact measurement.

You will partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics teams to build data-driven solutions used by millions of users.

This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identify and lead data science opportunities that improve growth, engagement, retention, revenue, and user experience
Build machine learning models for personalization, recommendations, user behavior prediction, segmentation, and forecasting
Develop solutions supporting churn prevention, lifetime value optimization, fraud detection, and Macadam’s reward economy
Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, causal inference, and other advanced statistical methods
Take models from initial exploration to production, working closely with Data and Engineering teams
Define clear success metrics and evaluate solutions based on measurable product and business impact
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to Macadam’s data science roadmap, standards, and best practices




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Science, or a similar role
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience using BigQuery, GCP, dbt, and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel or Firebase Analytics
Experience developing, deploying, and evaluating machine learning models
Familiarity with data pipelines and production machine learning workflows
Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, experimentation, and model evaluation
Experience working with large behavioral, transactional, or product datasets
Strong product and business mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Fluent in English




NICE TO HAVE

Experience with consumer mobile apps, gaming, advertising, loyalty, or rewards products
Experience with recommender systems, personalization, churn, LTV, or fraud models
Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, or large-scale experimentation
Familiarity with mobile attribution frameworks, including Apple’s SKAdNetwork




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Be part of a mission-driven company making a tangible difference in people's lives, one step at a time.
Real ownership: lead high-impact data science initiatives and build solutions used by millions from day one.
Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and international exposure.
A supportive, talented, and passionate international team.
Offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Meal voucher.
Wellness allowance (powered by Urban Sports).
Private healthcare (Alan).
Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
4 additional Macadam holiday days.
Friday team lunch.
Company events and offsites.




WHY MACADAM?

We don’t just talk about change - we walk it.

Our principles:

Make it happen - take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.
Build together, win together - support and challenge each other to go further.
Trust the data - decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.
Build for people - design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.
Think bigger - set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Title: Global Data Scientist Specialist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

Avolta is the world’s leading travel experience player. With a traveler-centric philosophy and a geographically diverse network, the travel retail and F&B company addresses the needs of up to 2.3 billion passengers each year, with 5,500 outlets in more than 75 countries across six continents. Description:
Senior Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

You will have the opportunity to crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies as well as solve problems using state of the art AI algorithms. You will have the chance to debate and explore new ideas, approaches and technologies with your team to design and implement the best solutions. We follow the philosophy of using the right tool for the right job and are not afraid to explore the greenfield. You will be a key player in the organisation; designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimising the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Within the Data Science team, we are focussed on researching and building cutting-edge solutions to evolve better travel experiences for our customers, all by leveraging the information from over 30 million searches that we receive everyday! Due to this scale, we are able to have a wider and better selection of travel plans that are tailored to suit the traveller’s needs which is probably more than any other travel site.. Machine learning models in production make over 1.8 Billion predictions a day improving customer experience and helping drive better decisions in an ever changing environment. The team is constantly evolving the next generation of models using cutting edge algorithms and technology to improve our goals to drive value for our customers.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 6.5M members in Prime
16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches
8 Billion ML predictions per day - Up to 1.8 billion daily AI predictions[e1]
1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel subscription program.

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science team, you will be in charge of:


Work with multi-disciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive value and growth for both our customers and business.
Take ownership of initiatives and ensure successful delivery from initiation to final outcome.
Provide transparency on initiatives to the team and stakeholders.
Influence and advice stakeholders on the best course of action.
Keep up-to-date on the advancements in the area of machine learning and AI.
Lead and mentor data scientists.
Act as an evangelist for machine learning and AI.
Adhere to company values, create and maintain a friendly working environment.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or other quantitative fields);
5+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, AI expert or Machine Learning engineer;
A solid understanding of relevant statistical, data processing and machine learning methods and their implementation using standard open source frameworks;
Experienced with building production ready machine learning solutions and MLOps;
Experienced Python developer. Other programming languages are a plus;
Experience with cloud platforms and scalable solutions;
Experience creating solutions powered by Generative AI, specially Large Language Models, and LLM frameworks like LangChain will be a plus;
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation.

Experience working with large or unstructured datasets


Our offer

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for a Data Scientist to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

The role sits inside the BI team in Ryanair Labs. The BI team are made up of 95+ people split across the three Ryanair offices: Dublin, Madrid & Wroclaw. Within the BI team there is a range of different professions: Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Optimization Engineers, Data Modellers, BI Analysts, BI Reporters & BI Developers.

The Role


Lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced models and algorithms to optimise pricing strategies, segmentation or forecasting across the business.
Work autonomously to scope and deliver analysis of performance metrics, identifying the questions worth answering rather than waiting to be handed them.
Apply sophisticated statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms to analyse historical data, forecast demand, and identify pricing and revenue opportunities.
Conduct in-depth analysis of performance metrics, including revenue impact, price elasticity, and customer segmentation, to assess the effectiveness of strategies and drive continuous improvement.
Communicate findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex analysis into decisions stakeholders can act on.
Mentor and collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners, providing guidance on best practices, analytical methodologies, and data visualisation techniques.
Relevant Degree in field of Data Science (or similar), Masters/PhD preferable.
3+ years professional experience in Data Science positions.
The candidate must be commercially astute and be able to recognise the value of projects. Commercial value added is a key component of job performance. Experience working in Commercial department is essential. Experience in product pricing is desirable.
Be a self-starter and consistently show initiative & diligence on a daily basis. The team is built up of people who generate ideas and show initiative in the work they do.
Communication skills – most projects involve multiple people across various teams in different departments across the three offices. The role will involve regular presentations.


Tech Requirements


Strong Python and SQL experience is a necessity.
Experience with Databricks.
Basic knowledge of a cloud provider.
Ability to build and deploy predictive models. An understanding of and experience with the following is required: Machine Learning topics (clustering, forecasting, classification, anomaly detection).
Experience using Gen AI to assist in your day to day tasks.
Ability to quickly put together slide decks that summarize your analysis, and clearly tell a story. Have expertise in designing a range of styles of slide decks for varying audiences.
We promote innovation, several PoCs of new technologies or innovative ideas are launched every week.
A competitive but flexible technical career plan.
Financial support for conferences and training courses as well as official certifications. We encourage you to attend training events and conferences, this is key for us to keep up to date with the most advanced techniques and technologies.
Possibility for career growth in a continuously growing team.
We believe in a hybrid working model, you can work up to three days per week remote, but you are also going to enjoy the excellent work environment at our modern offices in the heart of Madrid
Optional discounts on health insurances (various companies).
Travel discounts, of course!

Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range of application areas. As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about our solutions and innovations, visit our website here.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with experience developing machine learning solutions and analytical models, from experimentation to validated production-ready models. You will work closely with the Product Owner, Data Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and Data Analysts to transform business challenges into scalable AI solutions and data products.

How You'll Make An Impact


Design, develop, and validate machine learning models through iterative experimentation and PoC cycles.
Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business problems, define use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
Develop forecasting, predictive, and analytical models, with strong focus on time series use cases.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and MLOps Engineers to deliver AI and ML solutions efficiently.
Perform feature engineering, model validation, and model performance analysis.
Build demo-ready PoCs and visualizations to communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
Track experiments, metrics, and model evolution using MLflow.
Work with analytical datasets and contribute to the definition of datasets and features for ML use cases.
Contribute to technical standards, best practices, and AI/ML solution design.


What Makes You a Great Fit

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About The Role

The data science team, currently 11 members, focuses on pricing, classification of open banking data and credit decisioning. All data scientists actively contribute to building Render and adapting it to different use cases and products, by being directly embedded in the tech team. As we launch in Spain, we're hiring our first local data scientist to build out the credit risk model for the Spanish market, working closely with both our local Spanish team and our London-based Data Science team.

What You'll Be Doing


Work with our local Head of Credit Risk to build and develop the local credit risk model for the Spanish market, from initial development through to ongoing iteration and performance monitoring
Evaluate, select and integrate local data providers (bureau, Open Banking, alternative data) to power credit decisioning in Spain
Own reporting for the Spanish business: designing the dashboards, metrics and analytics infrastructure that give the team visibility into portfolio performance, risk and affordability
Work closely with the London-based data science team to adapt Render to the Spanish market, sharing methodology, code and lessons learned across geographies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. product, finance, collections, underwriting, and the local credit risk and country leads) to translate data insights into pioneering solutions that drive product strategy and growth in Spain
Stay abreast of industry trends in AI, machine learning, and fintech to drive innovation


Who You Are


You have an advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field
You’ve got 3+ years of experience in a data science role. Credit risk or finance experience is a plus but not required, as you'll be supported by strong local expertise from our credit risk lead and country director
Strong SQL & Python skills and experience working directly with large datasets
You have a strong background in statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
You're passionate about leveraging AI and data to improve financial inclusion and access to fair credit
You have excellent communication skills and can translate complex data insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working across English and Spanish
You're adaptable, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Experience with AWS is a plus


This position is based in Madrid with a hybrid work arrangement requiring 3 days per week on-site in our office in Las Rozas, Madrid.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​


Gameloft Barcelona is seeking a Data Scientist to join Gameloft Global Data team.

As a Data Scientist, you will be able to deep dive into our massive streams of player data in-game, prototype and deploy machine learning models to increase game revenue. You will help move projects from exploratory analysis to deployed models across live titles, including life-simulation and racing games.




What it means on a daily basis​


Analyse large-scale player data with Python and SQL, transforming it into clear, actionable insights.
Perform feature engineering on large-scale data from the data warehouse, managing your code with Git.
Prototype and improve machine learning models and prediction pipelines, using experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing to raise performance baselines.
Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders across the game teams.


What success will look like​


In your first months, you will ramp up on our data infrastructure and deliver your first exploratory analyses.By the middle of your onboarding, you will be responsible for features or models end-to-end, framing problems clearly and presenting them to non-technical stakeholders. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About The Company

Scrambly is one of the fastest-growing adtech startups in the world, featured in the AppsFlyer Performance Index and Singular ROI Index in just 3.5 years.

We’re growing 250%+ YoY across revenue, team, product, and technology — fully bootstrapped and profitable.

We’re building the future of app discovery: a reward-powered alternative to the App Store and Google Play. Our loyalty-driven ecosystem connects millions of users with the world’s top apps and delivers unmatched, ROI-focused growth for mobile advertisers.

Our mission is to build a true alternative to traditional app stores — fueled by rewards and data — and create a new, performance-first growth engine for mobile app advertisers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the models behind how Scrambly spends and makes money — what our users are worth, what we should pay to acquire and reward them, and how we keep the ecosystem free of abuse.

The centre of the role is predicting user and cohort value — forecasting what people will be worth from early signal, and keeping those forecasts accurate as the product and the market move underneath them. Around it sits a set of connected problems across marketing, monetisation, and risk, each of which turns a prediction into a decision the business acts on. We will go through the specifics with you during the process.

You will own the modelling end to end: framing the problem, building the model, deciding how it is evaluated, and staying with it once it is live. You will not be doing that alone — you will work closely with our engineers on data, pipelines, serving, and integration.

This is an early hire on a data team being built from scratch, reporting to and working day to day with the Head of Data. We are flexible on level. The title reflects the ownership and independence the role carries, not a hard experience bar — we will set the level, title, and compensation to match what you bring.

Key Responsibilities


Value prediction. Own and improve how we forecast user and cohort value from early behaviour, across our different revenue streams. Improve accuracy where it matters most commercially, and keep the models working as the product changes.
Bidding and pricing. Build the modelling that decides what we are willing to pay to acquire users, together with the controls that keep spend inside margin limits while the system is still learning.
Segmentation and targeting. Build the scoring and segmentation that lets us treat users, partners, and inventory according to the value they actually deliver.
Fraud and abuse. Improve the accuracy of our fraud models, and balance catching abuse against wrongly penalising real users.
Evaluation. Decide how each model is judged and hold that line — out-of-sample discipline, backtesting, and choosing metrics that reflect the commercial objective rather than the convenient one. Stay close to your models once they are live, and flag when accuracy starts to slip.
Collaboration. Work with the Head of Data on prioritisation, with our engineers on data pipelines and serving, and with commercial teams on turning model output into decisions they trust.


Requirements


4+ years as a data scientist working on production models that drive real decisions. We care more about what you have owned than about the number.
Hands-on experience with LTV or ROAS prediction — forecasting user or cohort value from early behaviour, and dealing with the problems that come with it: immature cohorts, long horizons, sparse segments, and models that decay as the product changes. This is the core of the role and we are looking for someone who has done it before.
Adtech or mobile performance marketing background — attribution and MMP data, cohort and campaign economics, and how UA spend actually gets decided. Backgrounds in gaming, gambling, or user-incentive and loyalty systems are equally relevant, and experience with rewarded, offerwall, or incentivised apps is a significant advantage.
Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on a cloud data warehouse — BigQuery preferred.
Rigour about evaluation: you choose the metric that matches the business objective, you are careful about out-of-sample and point-in-time correctness, and you are willing to say a model is not good enough to ship.
Experience of models that made it into production and were used to make real decisions — you understand what it takes to get there and what happens to a model afterwards.
Commercial judgement and clear communication — able to explain a model to people who will spend money based on it, and to push back when the data does not support the question being asked.
A proactive, self-directed way of working. You will be in a very small team, with a lot of latitude and little process.
English at B2+, written and spoken — you will document your work and work daily with an international team.


Nice to Have


Bidding, pricing, or budget allocation systems — control loops, bandits, or other approaches to spending under uncertainty.
Fraud, anomaly detection, or trust & safety modelling, especially with weak or incomplete labels.
Experimentation and causal inference — A/B design, power analysis, and incrementality measurement.
Survival, hierarchical, or Bayesian methods applied to retention, monetisation, or sparse-segment problems.
BQML, Dataform, or dbt, or other experience building models close to the warehouse.
Deploying and monitoring models yourself — pipelines, serving, retraining, and drift monitoring.


What We Offer


Ownership of the models that set UA spend, offer payouts, and fraud decisions — work directly attached to revenue, with visible impact within weeks.
Problems with real depth: long-horizon forecasting, adaptivity, pricing under uncertainty, and fraud with imperfect ground truth.
A close working relationship with the Head of Data, a real say in how the data function is built, and room to grow as the team expands.
A level and compensation matched to what you bring, rather than to the title on the advert.
A profitable, bootstrapped company growing 250%+ YoY, where investment in data is justified by results rather than budget cycles.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Modelado de datos, series temporales, algoritmia.

Conocimientos en modelos analíticos: series temporales, redes neuronales, regresiones, grafos, ML.
Experiencia en Deep Learning.
Entornos Azure, arquitecturas Big Data (Spark, Databricks).


Soft skills:


Capacidad analítica y conceptual.
Interlocución con cliente y definición de requisitos funcionales.
Liderazgo técnico y mentoring de perfiles junior.
Ética en el uso de datos (cumplimiento normativo, confidencialidad)

Description:
📍Ubicación: Barcelona ciudad – Sants-Les Corts

🕐Horario: Jornada completa partida con entrada y salida flexible y horario intensivo los viernes.

🏠Modelo híbrido: 3 días oficina/ 2 teletrabajo.

🚀 Incorporación: Inmediata




En Vincle buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo de Desarrollo de Producto e impulsar nuevas capacidades de Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y Analítica Predictiva.

Trabajarás en un entorno muy colaborativo junto a equipos de Producto, Arquitectura y Desarrollo, con un objetivo claro: convertir datos y oportunidades de negocio en funcionalidades inteligentes, escalables y con impacto real.

👉 Todo ello con impacto directo en nuestro producto SaaS B2B (CRM/SFA) y en clientes de sectores como Gran Consumo y Pharma.




🧩 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Transformar datos en capacidad real de producto: modelos predictivos, recomendaciones, optimización y nuevas funcionalidades basadas en IA.

Tu trabajo no se quedará en el análisis: llegará a producción y generará impacto real en negocio.




🚀 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de Machine Learning y Analítica Predictiva.
Trabajar en casos de uso de predicción de ventas, forecasting, recomendación, optimización, detección de anomalías y segmentación.
Desarrollar motores de recomendación y mecanismos de scoring.
Investigar, evaluar y prototipar soluciones basadas en IA Generativa y LLMs.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo (Arquitectura, Tech Leads y Desarrollo) para integrar, desplegar, monitorizar y evolucionar los modelos en producción.
Participar en el desarrollo de asistentes inteligentes y capacidades conversacionales.
Trabajar con Prompts Engineering, arquitecturas RAG y enfoques híbridos que combinen IA generativa y modelos predictivos.
Traducir necesidades de negocio y producto en soluciones de IA técnicamente viables.
Medir, iterar y mejorar modelos para maximizar su impacto.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

✅ Imprescindible

Formación superior en áreas técnicas y analíticas o formación superior específica en Data Science (Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Telecomunicaciones, Data Science o similar).
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia profesional en Data Science / Machine Learning.
Dominio de Python y librerias como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow o PyTorch.
Experiencia desarrollando e implementando modelos predictivos.
Experiencia con IA Generativa y LLMs.
Conocimientos sólidos de estadística y modelización.
Dominio de SQL y/o NoSQL.
Capacidad para conectar tecnología, datos y necesidades de negocio.
Dominio de Castellano tanto hablado como escrito.




⭐ Valorable (muy relevante para nosotros)

Experiencia con Azure / Azure OpenAI.
Dominion de TypeScript / Node.js.
Conocimientos de RAG, LangChain, Semantic Kernel o tecnologías equivalentes.
Experiencia en MLOps.
Azure / Databricks / Spark.
Experiencia en producto SaaS B2B.
Experiencia en sectores como Retail, Gran Consumo o Pharma.




Buscamos a alguien que no solo quiera construir buenos modelos, sino verlos convertidos en producto. Una persona con mentalidad práctica, curiosidad por las nuevas posibilidades de la IA y ganas de generar impacto real trabajando con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.




✨ ¿Qué ofrecemos?

Incorporación a un equipo dinámico y creativo.
Participación en proyectos reales con impacto directo un SaaS consolidado.
Proyectos reales con clientes relevantes.
Entorno colaborativo, cercano y orientado a resultados.
Posibilidad de aprendizaje y desarrollo en un entorno profesional.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€38,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

📌 About the role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join an international project focused on developing and improving AI-powered document processing solutions.

In this role, you will work with LLMs, Vision-Language Models, OCR, NLP and Machine Learning to transform complex unstructured business documents into structured data.

You will collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Product teams and business stakeholders to develop and evaluate solutions that deliver measurable business value.

If you enjoy solving complex Data Science challenges and experimenting with AI to solve real business problems, this could be your next challenge!




💻 What you'll do

🔹 Design and improve AI solutions for document extraction, classification, validation and transformation.

🔹 Experiment with LLMs, multimodal models, OCR, NLP and Machine Learning to identify the best approach for each use case.

🔹 Develop prompts, structured outputs, validation and post-processing logic for complex document formats.

🔹 Build datasets and evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy and continuously improve solution performance.

🔹 Develop automated evaluations and regression tests to ensure robustness when models or pipelines change.

🔹 Write clean, reusable Python code and translate successful experiments into production-ready solutions with AI and Data Engineers.

🔹 Work with Product and business stakeholders to define use cases, success criteria and measurable AI solutions.




💡 Must Have

🔹 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or Applied AI.

🔹 Hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI, including prompt engineering and experimentation.

🔹 Strong understanding of NLP, Machine Learning and statistics, including when classical or deterministic approaches are more appropriate than LLMs.

🔹 Experience working with unstructured or semi-structured data, datasets, ground truth and evaluation metrics.

🔹 Strong Python skills and good practices around testing, version control and reproducible experimentation.

🔹 Experience analysing results and translating findings into measurable improvements.

🔹 Fluent English and spanish and ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

🔹 Degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.




✨ Nice to Have

🔹 Experience with Document Intelligence and OCR, particularly Azure Document Intelligence.

🔹 Experience with managed AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock.

🔹 Experience with document classification, information extraction or NER.

🔹 Experience applying multimodal or Vision-Language Models to document content and layouts.




🏢 Hybrid model – 2 days on site per week




🌍 Why join this project?




🤝 People first – diverse and inclusive culture in an international environment.

📊 Work on high-impact Data & Insights initiatives across business performance, operations, finance, and commercial domains.

🚀 Help shape how data supports strategic decision-making across a large international organisation.

🧠 Explore the evolution of AI-driven analytics, productivity tools, and data discoverability.

⚙️ Contribute to self-service analytics, data products, and scalable reporting practices.

📈 Work closely with business and senior stakeholders, turning complex data into meaningful insights.

😁 High team stability and collaborative culture.

🎓 €1200 per year training budget and continuous learning opportunities.

💰 Flexible compensation model.

🩺 Private health insurance and benefits package.

⚡ Flexible working hours and hybrid model.

🏋️ Wellhub: fitness, wellness, and mental health support.

⚽ Football and paddle tennis teams sponsored by Capitole.

🥳 Team buildings, global events, and strong tech communities.

👉 Ready for the challenge? Apply now!

Madrid (Hybrid, 2 days onsite)

Permanent

€48,000 - €53,000 p/a




Our client is an IT consultancy operating on a global scale who are looking to hire a Data Scientist to join their Core Modelling team. You’ll be working as part of a small team to build, train and evaluate machine learning models alongside senior team members who’ll guide you through the trickier problems. Presenting results clearly and for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Turn analysis into reports and visualisations using Tableau and Python

Previous experience in a Data Science role where you have gained a solid grounding in statistics, probability and core Machine Learning algorithms
Proficiency in Python including data manipulation libraries such as pandas or NumPy
Strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation
Experience with data visualisation libraries (malplotlib, seaborn, plotly) and creating reports in tools like Tableau
Strong teamworking skills but also the ability to work independently
Previous experience processing and exploring data in the iGaming sector would be an advantage but generally an industry involving predicting human behaviour in purchasing such as retail or banking could be suitable
